# Documentation theme

[Doxygen Awesome](https://github.com/jothepro/doxygen-awesome-css/tree/v2.5.0) v2.5.0,
vendored unchanged for reproducible, offline documentation builds:

- `doxygen-awesome.css`
- `doxygen-awesome-sidebar-only.css`
- `LICENSE.doxygen-awesome` (MIT)

`akreon.css` contains shared Akreon colors, typography, and spacing. Load it last.
To update, replace both upstream stylesheets and the license from the same tag,
then regenerate all three libraries' documentation.
